title: Antihypochondriac
summary: ANTIHYPOCHOND'RIAC, adjective [Gr. hypochondriac.] That counteracts or tends to cure hypochondriac affections, and depression of spirits. ANTIHYPOCHOND'RIAC, noun A remedy for hypochondriac affections

inlines.v: ANTIHYPOCHOND'RIAC, adjective [Gr. hypochondriac.] That counteracts or tends to cure hypochondriac affections, and depression of spirits. ANTIHYPOCHOND'RIAC, noun A remedy for hypochondriac affections and low spirits.
